title: Walks that fail in the full sweep
goal: The scripted walks are the app driving itself, and some of them no longer reach what they were written to check. Find out what each failing walk is looking for, then either fix the app if the walk is right or update the walk if the app moved on. This serves the focus because the sweep is the only thing that tells a focus runner whether the change it just made broke anything: a sweep with failures nobody has named cannot say that, so every focus feature ships on a weaker claim than it should.

keys-on-a-later-shadow-walk: the WALK HARNESS was wrong, not the app. A title's panel now has Reveal (and 3D) above Effects, so the whole Effects list starts under the dock's bottom edge. The reveal turned the dock by the slider's full depth inside the unscrolled list (810pt), carried the list off the top of the window, and the next round had nothing to turn. Fix: PlaytestReach.aim pulls the target onto the nearest edge of any scroller with nothing on screen, so the dock brings the list in and the list then scrolls itself (3 new PlaytestReachTests). Walk unchanged; passed 3 runs in a row, plus 14 other reveal walks green.

tutorial-component-versions-walk: a REAL app bug. After a second Add State the new state's name field sometimes never took the keyboard at all (walk run with a patient type step still failed after 2s: 3 of 5 runs). ComponentVersionRow asked for focus once, one pass later, and dropped the claim immediately. It now keeps asking (10 tries, 50ms apart) and lets the claim go only when the field has the keyboard, so a rebuilt row can pick it up. The harness's type step also waits up to 2s for a caret now. Passed 6 of 6 after, plus 8 other component-state walks green.

library-tile-click-latency-walk and section-fold-motion-walk: timing budgets missed under load, not regressions. Tile walk: failed 2 of the first 6 runs (35-36ms vs 33ms, both on click 2 of Kinetic Bold), then passed 7 in a row with worst 18-26ms, matching what the walk was written against. Fold walk: fails about 1 run in 3 or 4, each time on a different section (16.2 to 21.2ms against 16ms) with load average around 4.3 from other work on the Mac; typical folds 8 to 13ms. Both passed twice in a row. Budgets left alone on purpose. Left rough (does not clear the follow-up bar, a person cannot see a 3ms miss): the fold walk's headroom is about 3ms and shrinks as the dock gains sections, so it will keep flaking in sweeps under load.
